implementation.behavior: A single ephemeral focus-mode boolean controls CSS Grid dock visibility, ARIA aria-hidden/inert state, toolbar expanded state and the action explanation/icon. Exiting by button, either panel launcher or Escape restores the prior panel classes. The mode intentionally does not invoke persist(), update the Page Model, Save, or Publish.
implementation.desktop: The workspace uses its full center track; both dock columns are hidden with a scoped focus-state selector.
implementation.mobile: A 44px minimum touch target is present in the fixed action bar. The mobile backdrop is made transparent and non-interactive while focus mode is active; the canvas is no longer inert.
implementation.reuse_review: Reuses the existing workspace CSS Grid, dock classes, action registry/help, ARIA/inert synchronization and local panel persistence. No floating pane overlays the canvas. Two adapted Lucide 1.66.0 SVG shapes (focus, panels-top-left) use the existing ISC/MIT notices in docs/licenses/lucide-icons-1.66.0.txt. No external runtime package or service.
